text:
[NDBG.13.2.1] One variable per LHS binding. Variable name is the
binding name (`s`, `e`, etc.). Value is the schema type
(`Sensor`, `Event`). `variablesReference` is non-zero; drilling in
shows one child per slot.

```
s: Sensor
  entity_id: "kitchen_temp"
  value: 95.2
e: Event
  entity_id: "kitchen_temp"
  payload: "{\"temp\": 95}"
```
